stories.title: AI chip demand is pushing manufacturers to expand capacity
stories.description: AI infrastructure is becoming a major planning priority for chipmakers. AMD says it expects to substantially increase chip supply in 2027, while its leadership is discussing additional wafer, memory and manufacturing capacity with Asian partners. For readers, the bigger story is the supply-chain race behind the AI boom: computing demand is now influencing investment decisions across several semiconductor markets.

stories.title: Africa's growth outlook improves, but investment remains the key test
stories.description: The World Bank has raised its 2026 growth forecast for Africa to 4.3%. The upgrade points to stronger performance across much of the region, while the bank is also urging governments to invest in artificial intelligence and digital capabilities. The important question is whether faster growth can translate into productivity, jobs and broader access to technology.

stories.title: Indian shares advance as markets look toward the RBI decision
stories.description: Indian equities extended their rebound on Tuesday, with banks and Trent among the stocks supporting the move. Investors are also watching the Reserve Bank of India's next policy decision and broader global signals. The session shows how domestic monetary policy and international market conditions are increasingly being weighed together by Indian investors.

stories.title: Gold holds firm as traders reassess the path for US interest rates
stories.description: Gold edged higher on Tuesday as traders reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate increase in October, even while the dollar and Treasury yields remained firm. The movement highlights the competing forces affecting the metal: expectations for monetary policy on one side and higher yields and a stronger currency on the other.

stories.title: India remains among the countries seeking the 2036 Olympics
stories.description: India is one of seven countries still in contention to host the 2036 Summer Olympics, according to the International Olympic Committee. Germany, Qatar, Hungary, South Korea and South Africa are also listed among the candidates. The IOC expects a shortlist in 2027, with a preferred host to be named in 2028 and the final decision expected in 2029.

stories.title: Sourav Ganguly appointed Delhi Capitals head coach for 2027 IPL
stories.description: Former India captain Sourav Ganguly has been appointed head coach of Delhi Capitals for the 2027 Indian Premier League season. It marks another step in his coaching career after his work with Pretoria Capitals in South Africa's SA20 competition.

stories.title: Jannik Sinner ends his 2026 season to continue knee recovery
stories.description: World number one Jannik Sinner will not compete again in 2026 as he continues recovering from a knee injury. The decision removes the top-ranked player from the remainder of the season and shifts attention to the closing tournaments and the wider race for the year-end rankings.

stories.title: UK regulator opens first Online Safety Act investigation into Meta
stories.description: Britain's communications regulator Ofcom has opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act. The case examines whether Meta properly assessed risks associated with Instagram Instants before its launch. Meta says it carried out a risk analysis, while the regulator is examining whether its duties were met.
